links.comparator_used: Direct Query Prompt without dietary guidelines (relying on the model's built-in knowledge)
links.outcome: Accuracy in classifying recipes as suitable or not suitable for diabetes
links.effect: No numbers in the abstract; models able to reason with the guidelines performed better, and most LLMs were cautious in predicting recipes as suitable
links.tradeoff: Most LLMs were overly cautious, avoiding 'suitable' predictions to prevent detrimental outcomes
links.quote: Further, the models that can reason using the dietary guidelines performed better in predicting the suitability of recipes for diabetes.
